outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs illumination overhead as single calculated percentages per condition, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot with shaded mean±s.e.m. bands; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Scatter plot of mean ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional individual data points.
Line plots showing individual cell migration tracks over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Bar chart of mean migration speed with error bars has individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of micrographs (Mitotracker/Paxillin/Merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows a time-series of micrographs, not a plot.
Panel H shows a time-series of micrographs, not a plot.
Line plot with mean±s.e.m. of normalized cell area over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Line plot with mean±s.e.m. of normalized mitochondrial area over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
